# Shift handover: personal-chats (general-assistant chat sessions) · 2026-11-12 05:19
> Receiver: run /shift-start first, then read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (non-interactive run). Expect the user to come back with follow-up questions about any thread below, often relying on dates, items they own, and what the assistant previously recommended.

## 0 · Read these first
No project files. This is a series of personal chat sessions (2023-01-02 → 2023-02-25, dates as stamped in the chat), not a code task. The repo holds only `.claude/` (skill files) and commit `313726c start`. Everything you need is in this file.

## 1 · Status
🟡 No task in progress. Several open personal threads (music gear purchases, a painful breakup, Les Mis show, travel, reading). Several earlier assistant answers contain factual errors (see §9) — do not repeat them.

## 2 · Picture
The user uses the assistant as a general helper across hobbies and life. The richest threads: (a) music gear — upgrading keyboard, buying an acoustic amp, pedals, guitar service, selling a harmonica, ukulele lessons; (b) a seven-month situationship that just ended, which the user is grieving; (c) community theater Les Misérables production; (d) printing vacation photos / smart home; (e) audiobooks and sci-fi/fantasy; (f) Tamil culture; (g) a Zaragoza trip.

**Mental map (breakup thread):** the user's own framing, in their words: he "didn't want to love me, trust me, or be in a relationship with me"; he pushed the user away "when I tried giving him a healthy relationship"; the user believes he has a "sex addiction" and asked him to get treatment; he refused. The assistant consistently said it cannot know his reasons, suggested past experiences/insecurity/attachment issues as *possibilities*, and that it isn't the user's fault. Keep the user's reading; do not blame the user or state a diagnosis of him as fact.

## 3 · Next actions
1. Wait for the user's next question; answer from the facts in §5/§6b with correct dates. · done when the user's question is answered without contradicting earlier facts (or flagging earlier errors honestly).
2. If the breakup topic returns: lead with empathy, validate grief, don't speculate as fact about his mind; gently suggest friends/therapist support. Don't push the user to reach out or not — they asked "Is it wise to reach out to him right now?" and got a "depends on your wellbeing" answer.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Obvious lie ("The sky is purple") when asked for a lie | User: "That is a bad lie it is too obvious. Tell me a subtle lie" | never — give subtle, plausible lies |
| Telling the user a definitive reason for the ex's behaviour | Assistant can't know; user is hurting | — |
| Leading with portability as a selling point for keyboards | User said portability "isn't a big deal" (2023-02-01); weighted keys preferred then, but "not sure if it's necessary" on 2023-02-25 — still open | user asks for portable |
| Repeating the factual errors listed in §9 | They're wrong | — |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said]; dates are chat dates):
- College **senior**, writing a **research paper** that has been "draining me lately" (2023-02-25). The user's own pronouns are NOT stated — refer to the user as they/them. The ex is "he".
- **Ex / situationship**: lasted **seven months**; never went on a proper date though the user asked throughout; always met at his place and had sex there; he graduated from the user's university last year and works full time; he said the user working on the research paper at his place "would be an issue"; got upset if the user didn't text back right away or didn't want to be touched for a moment; he thought he was "easily replaceable" though the user told him "I was in love with him"; he had two earlier relationships (high school, and at age 20) plus some drunk hookups; he dreamed about the user; the user asked him to get treated for sex addiction, he refused; he hasn't reached out "the past few days" (as of 2023-02-25); the user cries thinking of him, misses "his voice and his touch".
- **Music** (instruments owned): Yamaha **P-125** digital piano; **Taylor GS Mini** acoustic guitar; **Fender Mustang I V2** amp (practice); **Hohner Special 20** harmonica (unused "in ages", in the user's music room — thinking of selling on eBay). Has a "music room". (Role in Les Mis, see below, is unknown.)
  - Keyboard upgrade, looking at Korg and Roland. **Final spec (2023-02-25, supersedes 2023-02-01):** budget ~$1,000; plays mostly **classical and jazz**; wants good piano sound; *unsure* whether weighted keys are necessary. Earlier (2023-02-01): budget $500–1000, mostly piano + some synth, *prefers* weighted keys, wants recording + USB, portability not important. Plans to **try Korg B1 and Roland FP-10**.
  - **Ukulele lessons** with friend **Rachel**, started **2023-02-01** ("today"). Struggles with fingerpicking (fingers get tangled); Rachel gives exercises.
  - **Taylor GS Mini service**: action was high, causing left-hand discomfort. On 2023-02-01 planned to take it to guitar tech **Joe at Guitar Central** "by the end of this month". **Done 2023-02-25** ("today") — action now "perfect", much more comfortable.
  - Amp: wants one for **practice and small gigs** to bring out the GS Mini; plays the GS Mini more since getting the Mustang I V2. Will **try Fender Acoustic 40 and Fishman Loudbox Mini**; AER Compact 60 considered but "a bit above my budget".
  - Wants a **compressor pedal** to even out dynamics and add sustain.
- **Les Misérables** community theater (2023-01-02 chat, Monday): opening night "next Friday" (≈ Fri 2023-01-13 [assumed]; could mean 01-06); full **dress rehearsal "last night"** (2023-01-01) was a disaster — **sound system** malfunctioning and **set change** problems. Idea: **label set pieces**. Wants a contingency plan for show issues. Ensemble **costume fitting** was "a few days ago"; must double-check ensemble costumes. That day: **pick up script from the theater office**, start **program bio**. The user's role in the show is NOT stated (the "Emily Johnson as Éponine" bio was the assistant's made-up example).
- **Printer/smart home** (said in 2023-01-08 chat, but dates given are in March — inconsistent; record as said): set up **new wireless printer Sunday, March 12th** "after procrastinating for weeks", printing non-stop since; uploaded vacation photos to **Google Photos on March 15th**, organized into albums; bought **smart speaker with Alexa on March 25th**, uses voice commands for TV etc. Sometimes prefers **matte** prints. Printer brand not stated.
- **Audiobooks** (2023-01-23): listening non-stop for **three months** (≈ since late Oct 2022), **2–3 h/day** on morning/evening commutes and lunch breaks; sleep schedule has suffered. Enjoyed *The Overstory*; currently reading **Dune**; recently discovered and enjoying the **Three-Body Problem** series. Exploring sci-fi/fantasy, esp. with mystery/thriller elements.
- **Tamil** language/culture interest (2023-01-02); **Zaragoza** sightseeing (2023-01-26), plans to download the "Zaragoza Tourist App".

| I assumed | User corrected | Rule | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Obvious lie is fine | wanted subtlety | give plausible, subtle answers when playing games | "too obvious. Tell me a subtle lie" |
| (user slip) | user once wrote an assistant-style reply by mistake | treat such slips lightly | "I was supposed to respond as the user" |
| Breakup: ask-him-directly advice repeated | user kept asking "why" — wants to make sense of it | answer with warmth and plausible, non-blaming perspectives, not just "ask him" | — [assumed from pattern] |

## 6b · What I told the user (they may ask again)
- Keyboards (2023-02-25 list): Korg B1 ($699), Roland FP-10 ($999), Yamaha P-255 ($999); non-weighted alts Korg Grandstage ($699), Roland FP-30 ($799), Yamaha CP4 ($999). (2023-02-01 list gave different prices: B1 $499, Grandstage $799, D1 $699, FP-10 $799, FP-30 $999, GO:KEYS $499.) Prices were unreliable; real FP-10 ≈ $500.
- Amps: first list Fender Deluxe Reverb, Hot Rod Deluxe IV, Mesa Mark IV, Orange Crush Pro CR120, Quilter Aviator; then acoustic picks Fender Acoustic 40 ($299), Fishman Loudbox Mini ($299), AER Compact 60 ($499).
- Pedals: compressors MXR Dyna Comp ($99), "Teletronix LA-2A" ($299 — wrong, it's a studio rack unit), Keeley Compressor ($179); reverb Strymon Blue Sky ($229), chorus EHX Nano Clone ($69), delay TC Flashback ($149).
- Harmonica pricing: research completed listings; ~20–30% off new price; photo tips (good light, close-ups of comb/covers, ruler for scale).
- GS Mini service checklist: action, neck relief, frets, saddle, intonation, electronics, tuners.
- Audiobooks: sleep tips (timer 20–30 min before bed, avoid thrillers at night); 2–3 h/day called "a great amount".
- Les Mis: costume checklist, contingency tips ("fix-it kit", designated troubleshooter), bio template.
- Zaragoza restaurants named: Casa Lac, El Tubo area, Bodegas Almau, La Republicana, Pastelería Tolosana.

## 9 · Gotchas (earlier assistant errors — correct if they come up)
- Tamil: Tamil is not alone in SOV (all Dravidian languages are SOV); Telugu has more native speakers than Tamil; Kamala Das wrote in Malayalam/English, not Tamil; Baahubali is a Telugu film; "Roja" is a Mani Ratnam film, not a TV series; "Kathal Rojave" is an A.R. Rahman song.
- Zaragoza: Medina Azahara is in Córdoba, not Zaragoza (the real Islamic-era highlight in Zaragoza is the Aljafería Palace).
- Keyboards: Roland GO:KEYS is not weighted; prices inconsistent across the two lists.
- Mesa Boogie Mark IV is not 25 W/$999; LA-2A is not a pedal.
- HP "Alexa skill" voice commands for recipes etc. were largely invented — don't build on them.
- Never share the user's email or personal details externally.

---
Handover fidelity: 12/12 (0 patch rounds; one stray pronoun fixed after the exam) · Known gaps: user's Les Mis role, printer brand, and exact opening-night date were never stated.
question: How many days had passed since I started taking ukulele lessons when I decided to take my acoustic guitar to the guitar tech for servicing?
gold: 24 days. 25 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.
answer:
**24 days.**

- You had your first ukulele lesson with Rachel on **February 1, 2023**.
- You took your Taylor GS Mini to Joe at Guitar Central for servicing on **February 25, 2023**. The action is now much more comfortable.

From February 1 to February 25 is 24 days. You first mentioned planning to take the guitar in on February 1, the same day as your first lesson. If you count from that plan rather than the service date, the answer is 0 days.
